summary: Restrict document downloads to HTTPS Logitech hosts, preserve existing files, and report failed sync cleanup.
reason: Redirects could leave Logitech, downloads could overwrite user files, and failed deletion reconciliation could be reported as a complete sync.
validated_outcome: Offline tests reject off-host redirects and existing or symlinked download targets, preserve a replacement file after a failed write, report a partial download without deleting it, and propagate flat and dependent sync reconciliation failures even when other parents succeed.
